title: Vault's Login MFA feature did not consistently enforce the lifetime of pending two-phase login requests (CVE-2026-92738)
description: Vault's Login MFA feature had a vulnerability where it did not consistently enforce expiration of pending two-phase login requests. This flaw could allow a user who completed the first authentication factor to finalize MFA and obtain a Vault token after the request should have expired, even if the user's primary credential was rotated. The issue is fixed in Vault Community Edition 2.2.2 and Vault Enterprise versions 2.2.2, 1.21.14, and 1.19.26.
